blocks.orig: Bluebay Beach Resort & Spa is a five-star beachfront resort on the east coast of Zanzibar, set within 12 hectares of tropical gardens with more than 1,000 palm trees. With a variety of rooms and suites, the resort caters to different tastes and needs. You can relax at the large swimming pool or head to the spa for treatments, while dining ranges from buffet-style meals to fresh seafood, Italian cuisine, and Asian flavours. With free WiFi across the resort and plenty of space to explore, there is always something to enjoy!
blocks.html: On the east coast of Zanzibar, Bluebay Beach Resort & Spa is a five-star resort right on the beach, set in 12 hectares of tropical gardens with over 1,000 palm trees. Its range of rooms and suites suits different tastes and needs. You can unwind by the large swimming pool or book a treatment in the spa, and the food varies from buffet meals to fresh seafood, Italian dishes and Asian flavours. Free WiFi is available throughout the resort, and with lots of space to explore, you will always find something to enjoy!
